5095393383934.sourceDescription:
The artificial Christmas tree features a white PVC construction designed to replicate the natural appearance of a festive evergreen. This high-quality material ensures the blades remain full and realistic while offering excellent resistance to crushing during storage and handling.

A sturdy metal stand provides superior stability compared to standard plastic bases, protecting your flooring with a protective cover. The robust base supports the tree securely, ensuring it remains upright and safe throughout the holiday season without tipping over.

Each tree includes approximately 650 tips spread across branches that are easily fluffed to create a dense, lifelike silhouette. The simple assembly process involves connecting a few pieces and straightening the branches for an immediate beautiful display ready for ornaments.

The tree stands at a height of 183 centimetres, making it an ideal size for living rooms and hallways. Its compact yet substantial presence allows it to serve as a central focal point for holiday decorations without overwhelming smaller domestic spaces.

This product is supplied as a single unit including the tree and its dedicated metal stand for immediate setup. All decorative items such as lights or baubles are not included, allowing customers to choose their preferred accessories to complete their unique festive theme.
Sturdy metal stand with protective cover ensures superior stability and floor protection.
High-quality PVC blades offer a realistic, full appearance and excellent crush resistance.
Includes approximately 650 tips for a dense, lifelike silhouette ready for ornaments.
Simple assembly process allows quick setup by connecting pieces and fluffing branches.
Guarantee - 1 month
Artificial christmas tree type: Hooked
Assembly required

Warm White Light
Warm white illumination gives the display a softer colour tone. It can be paired with surrounding decorative lighting to create a coordinated appearance in the intended setting.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Glitter Finish

Foldable Design
The folding design reduces the space needed between uses. It is useful when storage is shared with other belongings or when the item needs to be packed away after use.

8956086258434.baseName: 24 Pack Burgundy Velvet Christmas Bows 5 in by 7 in Tree Decorations Vintage Style Wreath and Garland Set
8956086258434.variantName: 24 Pack Burgundy Velvet Christmas Bows 5 in by 7 in Tree Decorations Vintage Style Wreath and Garland Set
8956086258434.sourceDescription:
Bring a warm, sophisticated tone to your Christmas display with this set of 24 burgundy velvet bows. The deep wine colour sits between plum and claret, which makes it a softer alternative to brighter festive tones and a natural match for cream, gold and eucalyptus accents. Each bow is cut from thick, soft velvet with a subtle sheen, giving a full, plush look that reads as vintage rather than shiny.

Every bow measures about 5 in wide and 7 in long and is tied from 3/8 in wide velvet ribbon. The compact size sits neatly on branches without weighing them down, and 24 pieces are enough for a full sized tree, a long garland or several wreaths. The velvet holds its shape well, so the loops stay rounded and the tails hang cleanly throughout the festive period.

Use the bows on Christmas trees, wreaths, garlands, wrapped gifts, stockings and table centrepieces, or add them to napkin ties and chair backs for a coordinated scheme. Keep a few spare for last minute wrapping, as the deep tone works just as well on plain kraft paper as it does on greenery. Fix each one with a clip or a short length of string if you want extra hold, and after Christmas store them flat in a dry box so they stay untangled and keep their shape for the following year.
Guarantee - 1 month

A milestone piece rather than a throwaway bauble

8941467468434.sourceDescription:

Each one is flat-cut acrylic roughly eight centimetres tall with its own cheerful snowman beside the letter, printed in colours that stay bright rather than fading to pastel after a season in the window. There's string already through the drilled hole, so it hangs wherever you want it.

Being acrylic rather than glass there's nothing to worry about if it gets knocked off a low branch by a tail. It also stores flat, so January packing takes minutes rather than requiring bubble wrap.

A neat way to include the pet on the tree
Around 8 cm flat-cut acrylic with a snowman companion
Colour stays bright rather than fading in sunlight
Already strung, ready to hang
Stores flat with no bubble wrap needed

Bring a soft, wintry glow to your festive decorating with this pre-lit micro LED sphere from MySmartBuy. Warm white micro LEDs on a stylish white metal frame create a glowing ball of light with a fresh, snowy feel. It is available in 40cm with 256 LEDs or 50cm with 320 LEDs. A hanging hook makes it easy to suspend from porches, pergolas, trees and ceilings, and the storage box keeps it safe for easy seasonal installation and reuse. Suitable for indoor and outdoor use. It is supplied with a 5m lead cable, giving plenty of reach from your socket, and the built-in timer takes care of switching it on and off, for effortless seasonal lighting. Festive lights are a simple way to bring warmth and atmosphere to dark winter evenings. Group them with candles, greenery and decorations, place them where they can be seen from outside, or use them to create a cosy corner for the family to enjoy throughout December. A simple, stylish way to bring festive sparkle into your home, and a lovely finishing touch for Christmas displays and parties.  Perfect For
 Front Door & Porch — An autumn greeting the moment you arrive, the envy of the street

 Cabinet Accents — Seasonal charm even in storage spaces

 Care & Usage Tips
Hanging: Use the loop on the back to hang on doors, walls or railings — ensure it's secure

Bring decorative colour, sparkle and seasonal detail to Christmas displays with this set of 18 light blue artificial eucalyptus with maple leaf picks, each measuring 17 cm. Designed with glittered eucalyptus with maple-style leaves and flexible wired stems, these decorative pick stems can be bent and shaped to suit different arrangements and display styles. They are perfect decorative accents for fuller arrangement showcases. They can also be arranged around wreaths and garlands, placed in vases and centrepieces, or incorporated into bouquets, mantel displays and other festive floral arrangements. The glittered leaves provide added colour, texture and sparkle, helping to introduce a decorative finish to seasonal displays. The wired stems make positioning easier, allowing the picks to be attached anywhere in floral arrangements and other decorative elements. Suitable for Christmas trees, wreaths, garlands, vases, table centrepieces, bouquets, gift displays and DIY craft projects, these artificial eucalyptus with maple leaf picks can be used as standalone decorative accents or combined with other Christmas decorations and floral pieces. The light blue colour can be incorporated into a range of festive decorating themes, from traditional seasonal arrangements to more coordinated displays. With a 17cm stem length and 18-piece quantity, this set provides flexible options for decorating different areas around the home, festive event spaces, or floral craft projects.
EUCALYPTUS WITH MAPLE LEAF PICKS LIGHT BLUE 18 PCS 17 CM: Includes 18 light blue glitter eucalyptus with maple leaf picks measuring 17 cm, featuring decorative leaves and flexible wired stems for arranging on Christmas trees, wreaths, garlands, vases, centrepieces, bouquets and festive floral displays
FLEXIBLE WIRED STEMS: The wired stems can be bent and shaped to suit different arrangements, making these artificial eucalyptus and maple leaf picks easy to position around Christmas trees, wreaths, garlands, floral displays, bouquets, and DIY decorations
GLITTERED EUCALYPTUS WITH MAPLE LEAVES: Glittered leaves add sparkle, colour and texture to festive arrangements, providing decorative accents for Christmas trees, wreath fillers, garlands, table centrepieces, mantel displays, vases and seasonal floral decorations
VERSATILE FESTIVE DECOR: Suitable for Christmas trees, wreaths, garlands, vases, bouquets, table centrepieces, mantel decorations, gift displays and DIY crafts; ideal for seasonal home decor, festive parties, weddings and floral arrangements
DIY FLORAL ARRANGEMENTS: The full floral eucalyptus with maple stems features perfect decorative accents for fuller arrangements. Bend, attach, and position the wired stems to customise Christmas displays, wreaths, garlands, bouquets, vases, and festive craft projects

Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Battery Powered
Battery power gives flexibility over positioning without relying on a nearby mains socket during use. Fit the specified battery type and follow the supplied instructions.

Pine Cone Detail
Pine cone details add texture among the festive foliage. Their recognisable shapes help create a woodland inspired arrangement, making the decoration easy to coordinate with other natural looking Christmas accessories.

Red Berry Accents
Red berry accents introduce small points of colour among the surrounding foliage. They add contrast to the festive arrangement and make it straightforward to repeat a red colour theme across neighbouring Christmas accessories.

Warm White Light
Warm white illumination gives the display a softer colour tone. It can be paired with surrounding decorative lighting to create a coordinated appearance in the intended setting.

Compact Format
The compact format helps the item fit into a smaller working or storage area. It is useful where you want the function close to hand without filling the whole space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Product details
Material: PVC. Stated size: 40 x 40 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.
Battery powered operation allows flexible positioning without needing a nearby mains socket.
Features realistic pine cone details and red berry accents for a traditional festive woodland look.
Includes warm white LED lighting to create a soft, coordinated glow on your door or display.
Compact 40x40 cm PVC design fits smaller spaces while adding a clear focal point to Christmas decor.
Comes with 1 Piece Christmas Wreath

5096042276034.baseName: Kinusaiga Christmas wreath kit - No-sew textile craft set with paper pattern guides for making a layered festive wall decoration
5096042276034.variantName: Kinusaiga Christmas wreath kit - No-sew textile craft set with paper pattern guides for making a layered festive wall decoration
5096042276034.sourceDescription:
Follow the paper pattern to work pieces of fabric into a textured Christmas design. The Kinusaiga-style technique makes a rewarding project for someone who likes the look of patchwork and wants to try working without stitches.

Working with cloth gives you control over the fullness of the finished piece. Even within one colour, the depth of a tuck and the way a loose edge falls can change the surface, giving the wreath a finish that is individual to its maker. Try arranging a few pieces beside one another before tucking them into the base. Two similar shades produce a softer patch of colour, while a change from light to dark makes an edge or small motif stand out.

A small fold changes the look of the cloth as it meets the base. Place each piece so that its outer edge remains visible and work across neighbouring areas in turn to keep the raised surface looking even. Let the folds around the edge follow the outline of the design. Turning the work towards you is often easier than trying to reach across the sections you have already completed, especially as the surface becomes fuller.

Unlike a flat printed hanging, the fabric surface has a profile of its own.

Once complete, try the decoration against the surface where you intend to display it. A plain background outlines the finished shape, while a nearby side light picks out the surface detail when viewed from an angle. If you make decorations together each winter, take a picture of the work before hanging it. A record of the colours and layout can be useful when choosing a new project or making another piece to hang alongside it.

Lay the finished piece face up when you put it away. A shallow box with enough room for the edges helps preserve the work and lets you bring it out again without first having to reshape the front.
Create a unique, textured Christmas wreath using the traditional Kinusaiga no-sew textile technique with included paper pattern guides.
Enjoy full creative control over the design by arranging fabric pieces to achieve your desired depth, colour gradients and three-dimensional finish.
This rewarding craft project allows you to work without stitches, making it an accessible and satisfying way to produce individual festive wall decorations.
The kit provides all necessary components for a layered, professional-looking holiday decoration that stands out against plain backgrounds.
Comes with Paper pattern guides

6313817004234.sourceDescription:
Product features:

 Multicolored orchid garland, outer diameter 40cm, standard door-hanging size; rich color options suitable for decoration in spring and summer seasons.
 Made of artificial floral materials, no need for watering for maintenance, long-lasting and not prone to wilting, can be reused.
 Wide range of applicable scenarios, such as front door wall hanging, entrance hall display window, garden setting, festival decoration, and shooting props.
 The garland frame is flexible, and after being compressed during transportation, it can be manually adjusted to restore the shape, lightweight and easy to hang.


 Product Specifications:

 Material: Plastic
 Quantity: 2/4/6/10 pieces 
 Color: Green
 Size: 40cm


Package contents:
Lilac garland × 2 / 4 / 6 / 10 pieces

 Notes:

 For ease of transportation, the products are shipped in compressed packaging. After receiving the goods, please manually adjust the leaves to achieve a full appearance.
 The new products may have a slight raw material odor. It will dissipate after being placed in a ventilated environment for 1-2 days.
 For long-term storage, please lay them flat and avoid heavy pressure to prevent the branches from deforming. This is a handmade product, and there may be slight differences in the arrangement of the leaves, which is not a quality issue.
 Please note: This product does not include a vase.
Perfect Year-Round Door Wreath: Elevate your front door decor with this summer wreath. Featuring lush artificial faux mums flowers, plastic leaves which can be adapted to any season, It’s a perfect choice for rustic-style accents or window decor.
Waterproof & UV-Resistant: This front door wreath is 100% handmade using high-quality artificial vine and plastic. The vivid faux mums flowers are washable , making it suitable for long-lasting outdoor or indoor decor.
Colorful & Full Lush Texture: This vibrant spring wreath is overflows with lifelike mums floral in a joyful mix of pinks, purples, yellows, reds and whites, set against deep green leaves.full and lush .Its full and lush design makes it a perfect door wreath for outside all season.
PERFECT FOR CELEBRATION: This wreath beautifully transitions from a spring and summer wreath for front door to a festive fall wreath or holiday wreaths for Christmas and Thanksgiving, while also serving as charming wedding decor, farmhouse entryway accent, or year-round home decoration.
THOUGHTFUL GIFT READY TO GIVE: This wreath arrives in a presentation-ready package, making it the perfect surprise gift for housewarmings, Mother's Day, birthdays, or as a beauty to any friend or loved one's home.

 This pre-lit Christmas garland features realistic frosted pine branches, decorated with natural pinecones and bright red berries, creating a classic snowy winter festive atmosphere. 
 Two versions are available: pre-decorated with warm white light string or plain garland without lights.

Made of PVC tips and real pine cones and branches of tree. With 300 individually crafted branch tips as charming as the real thing. Durable for long time use.
For Indoor or Outdoor Display: Easy to hang and fluff up nice and full. Used for hallway arch decor, stairs, front door or fireplace mantel; pre lit christmas garland for stairs
Perfect for Holiday Season: Add charm to your Christmas holiday with this eye-catching snow flocked 5' Christmas garland greenery. Create a festival environment suitable for Christmas, Hotels, Shopping malls, Party, Bars, Store Gate and Window; Garland for stairs railing

This autumn decoration adds a decorative detail to the chosen display. The orange finish and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for home decoration.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Father Christmas Motif

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.
